headline: Contested Belt Boils as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition, the contested belt has grown more active and its reported balances have changed. Gutter leads the movement, with 11 events in the past two hours and 51 over 24 hours; its present line is four Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral bases. WeatheredExpanse records two fresh events and 29 for the day, standing at five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral positions, while casualties for both sides are accelerating. PalantineBerm is another live sector, posting eight events in two hours and 24 in the day, with one Warden and six Colonial bases. Godcrofts has seen two events recently and 11 across 24 hours, leaving one Warden and eight Colonial holdings. MarbanHollow remains a mixed and busy front at three Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral bases, with 17 daily events and rising enlistment activity. NevishLine has recorded 19 daily events, though none in the latest two hours, and remains seven Warden to one Colonial. Heavy combat continues in CallahansPassage, but no strategic-base events are reported there. No victor is declared.
